Features

Applications

■ Multiple applications: parallel, series,

■ SEPIC topology

dual-inductor and transformer
■ Magnetically shielded, low radiation
■ Inductance range: 0.47 to 4000 μH
■ Rated current up to 17.6 A
■ RoHS compliant*

■ Power supplies for:

- Communication equipment
- Notebooks, desktop computers,
servers
- LCDs, flat panels, backlights
- Camcorders, HDTVs
